scope: Read-only numerical audit after the single coupled DC configuration was rejected. Nine instrumented repetitions of that frozen development configuration reproduce saved bytes exactly. No new quality configuration, scoring, peer-map replay or holdout access.

findings.quantizerMatrixMismatch: DC is rounded using the unrounded custom matrix, then decoded using the emitted half-precision matrix. This is an encoder/decoder step mismatch. Native sampled DC matrices are exact powers of two.

ac125MatrixAudit.policy: Read-only arithmetic decomposition of saved DC coefficients. Intended-grid reconstruction is a diagnostic, not an encoded candidate or measured quality gain. Uses the same quantized integers; re-quantizing with signaled steps has not been tried. No quality or holdout run.

proposedHelperTests.policy: Only the rounding helper and scalar luma quantization arithmetic were tested. No encoded candidate, new quality configuration or measured BD-rate. The proposal preserves the serialized DC matrix and aligns the quantizer with it.

proposal.scope: Round three DC matrix entries once to their existing emitted F16 values before DC rounding. Preserve serialized matrices, AC decisions, smoothing-off policy, existing DC rounding, entropy selection and all gates. This proposal has no new quality result.

archive.policy: First-party observation and numerical diagnostics only. No new quality configuration. Apply archive, then pass the archived observer path to prepare-dc-reconstruction-audit.ts.
